prose.text: Deleting an Xcode Cloud workflow permanently deletes its build history and artifacts. Only delete an Xcode Cloud workflow when you’re confident that you no longer need it and its build history or artifacts. Instead of deleting a workflow, deactivate it to preserve its build history and artifacts. To deactivate a workflow, use the `PATCH-v1-ciWorkflows-_id_` endpoint to set the workflow’s `isEnabled` attribute to `false` or deactivate it in the Xcode or App Store Connect. For more information about deactivating a workflow using Xcode or App Store Connect, see `Developing-a-Workflow-Strategy-for-Xcode-Cloud`.
